## 3. DESCRIPTION (Final Public Copy — Plain Text)
Before the day begins, the world is quiet enough to think clearly.
A CRT terminal glows softly as the sky shifts from deep blue into first light. The desk hums with low analog warmth — no pressure, no noise, just calm momentum and uninterrupted focus.
This 3-hour LoFi + Synthwave mix is built for early sessions before distractions arrive. Ideal for coding, planning, studying, or easing into creative work while the city still sleeps.
All music is royalty-free and safe for creators.
